_doc: Titan Forge (M3): TBUs (Titan Battle Units) are modular mechs assembled from one part per slot: head, core, two arms (armL and armR take any arm), back and legs. A TBU's UPow, speed, sight, Energy and cost are the sums of its parts. Abilities: lines = extra UPow % (role attack/defense, vsKaiju = only against kaiju), heal = extra HP per cycle at rest, amphibious = walks on any water (reaches rifts), hover = every land hex costs 1. requires = tech. weapon (arms) = tracer style in the Watch. callsign builds the TBU's name: '<legs> <core>'. TBUs never suffer the kaiju penalty and are built only at your Nodes. Art: assets/art/tbu_<slot>_<id>.png, 128x128, all parts on one shared joint layout so they stack (legs, back, rear arm, core, head, front arm).

parts.name: Sentinel Optics
parts.blurb: A plain sensor head. It sees what it needs to.

parts.name: Hunter Array
parts.blurb: Targeting eyes that lead every shot.

parts.name: Warden Crown
parts.blurb: An armoured cowl. It was built to stand in a gate and not move.

parts.name: Oracle Dome
parts.blurb: A glass dome full of drone-feeds. Sees over the horizon.

parts.name: Fission Core
parts.blurb: The standard torso: a fission pile, armour, and a reason to keep walking.

parts.name: Fusion Core
parts.blurb: A star in a box. Hotter, harder, hungrier.

parts.name: Riftheart Core
parts.blurb: A captured rift heart, still beating, wired into the chassis. The Abyss recognises it and flinches.

parts.name: Precursor Core
parts.blurb: Bought from the Guilds' black market. Nobody admits who built it first.

parts.name: Autocannon
parts.blurb: Belt-fed, reliable, loud.

parts.name: Plasma Lance
parts.blurb: A beam that turns armour into weather.

parts.name: Missile Pod
parts.blurb: Twelve tubes. Twelve opinions, all of them final.

parts.name: Riftblade
parts.blurb: A sword grown from rift-bone. It cuts Abyssians the way they cut everything else.

parts.name: Railgun
parts.blurb: A slug at a tenth of a percent of light speed.

parts.name: Aegis Arm
parts.blurb: A tower shield with a pistol bolted to the back.

parts.name: Sensor Mast
parts.blurb: A tall mast of antennae. Everything a little further away is a little closer.

parts.name: Missile Rack
parts.blurb: A shoulder battery for the opening volley.

parts.name: Repair Drones
parts.blurb: A hive of welders that live on the TBU's back and never stop fussing.

parts.name: Reactor Pack
parts.blurb: A backpack reactor. The TBU powers itself and gives the grid two Energy back.

parts.name: Strider Legs
parts.blurb: Two long legs. The default for a reason.

parts.name: Bulwark Treads
parts.blurb: Tank treads under a mech. Slow, and impossible to push back.

parts.name: Tidewalker Legs
parts.blurb: Sealed, ballasted legs that walk the sea floor. The only way to reach a rift on foot.

parts.name: Skylance Jets
parts.blurb: Jump-jets instead of feet. Mountains, forests and marsh all cost the same: one hop.
